title: Covid Sample Preparation for 384 Well Plate
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Initialize modules and plate
steps.instruction: Place the 384‑well plate on the temperature module; set both temperature modules to 4 °C; keep the reaction mix in well 1 of a 12‑well reservoir on the temperature module; plan to use the P20 multi‑channel pipette for filling full plates and the P20 single‑channel pipette for the final partially filled plate; fill samples and reaction mix by row while skipping columns; specify the Number of Samples and P20 Mounts before proceeding.

steps.title: Dispense reaction mix
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel (and single‑channel) pipette, aspirate 6 µL of reaction mix and multi‑dispense it into the 384‑well plate according to the attached grid and sample number, reusing the same tips for all wells.

steps.title: Dispense eluted samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 4 µL of eluted sample from the appropriate source plate to the 384‑well plate, following the grid and disposing of tips after each aspiration. Perform the transfers according to the sample range:

substeps.instruction: Samples 1–96: use the 8‑channel (and single‑channel) pipette to transfer 4 µL from Plate 1; discard tip after each aspiration.
Samples 97–192: use the 8‑channel (and single‑channel) pipette to transfer 4 µL from Plate 2; discard tip after each aspiration.
Samples 193–288: use the 8‑channel (and single‑channel) pipette to transfer 4 µL from Plate 3; discard tip after each aspiration.
Samples 289–384: use the 8‑channel (and single‑channel) pipette to transfer 4 µL from Plate 4; discard tip after each aspiration.
